# NICE CKS menopause: source check (by Hark, from a UK connection)

CKS is geo-blocked outside the UK, so the Claude Code cloud environment can't read it.
Hark checks it from the UK before each monthly review and records the result here.
Notes are a paraphrase only: CKS content is copyright Clarity Informatics (Agilio) under the CKS EULA,
so don't copy CKS text into this repo.

- Checked: 11 Nov 2026
- Topic: https://cks.nice.org.uk/topics/menopause/
- Last revised: May 2026 (minor update)
- Latest change (May 2026), paraphrased: added management of unscheduled bleeding on HRT, in line with NICE guidance; added fezolinetant following the NICE technology appraisal (TA1143).
- Previous change: July 2025, combined HRT may still be needed after hysterectomy in women with endometriosis.
- Changed since the last check: first check, baseline.

For the review: confirm the site's CKS reference cites "last revised May 2026", and that the site's fezolinetant and unscheduled-bleeding content is consistent with CKS.
